"""Stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.parsing import format_span


# ---
def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label for each stretch of opening hours with no cover.

    ValueError when any worked span runs outside the opening hours.
    """
    spans = list(worked)
    # check every worked span against the opening hours first
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            text = format_span(span)
            raise ValueError(f"{text} is outside opening hours")
    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    # walk the merged spans in order, labelling the space before each
    for span in merge_spans(spans):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_gap_label(Span(cursor, span.start)))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_gap_label(Span(cursor, opening.end)))
    return labels


def _gap_label(gap: Span) -> str:
    return f"gap {format_span(gap)} ({gap.minutes} min)"

import unittest

from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps
from hourglass.parsing import parse_span

OPENING = parse_span("09:00-17:00")


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_between_two_shifts(self):
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-12:00"), parse_span("13:00-17:00")]
        labels = find_gaps(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_before_and_after_work(self):
        worked = [parse_span("10:00-12:00")]
        expected = [
            "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
            "gap 12:00-17:00 (300 min)"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPENING), expected)

    def test_no_work_is_one_gap(self):
        labels = find_gaps([], OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_fully_covered_has_no_gaps(self):
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-17:00")]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPENING), [])

    def test_touching_shifts_leave_no_gap(self):
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-12:00"), parse_span("12:00-17:00")]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPENING), [])

    def test_overlapping_work_counts_once(self):
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-12:00"), parse_span("11:00-13:00")]
        labels = find_gaps(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 13:00-17:00 (240 min)"])

    def test_span_starting_before_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([parse_span("08:00-10:00")], OPENING)

    def test_span_ending_after_closing_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([parse_span("16:00-18:00")], OPENING)
